title: A falsification framework for causal claims in polygenic epidemiology: the insomnia–Alzheimer's disease test case
description: Analysis code and cached inputs for a six-level falsification framework for Mendelian randomization-based causal claims. Includes 25 R modules, Python simulation and figure-generation scripts, cached harmonised inputs for zero-API reproduction, and environment specifications (renv.lock).
notes: v1.1.0 English-only cleaned release for journal reproducibility. This repository accompanies the manuscript. Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21858125
